- Model consistently overestimates prices, especially in early forecast periods (first 5–10 days of 30d window).
- Forecasts show upward trend bias, failing to account for sharp downward corrections after spikes.
- Model underreacts to recent low prices; fails to mean-revert quickly when prices dip below historical averages.
- Overshoots after sharp price increases (e.g., post-90+ spikes), then fails to adjust downward in subsequent days.
- Forecasts lag behind true price movements by 1–3 days, particularly in volatile periods.
- Model exhibits “sticky” behavior — fails to adjust forecast slope when true price shows sudden divergence from trend.
- Overconfidence in linear extrapolation; ignores non-linear corrections or structural breaks in price behavior.
- Underestimates volatility in early forecast windows; overestimates stability in later days.
